key_patterns: Routes: `export const Route = createFileRoute('/_app/<path>')({ component: X })`. Params: `const { versionId } = Route.useParams()`. Navigate: `const navigate = useNavigate()` (from @tanstack/react-router) then `navigate({ to: '/standards/versions/$versionId', params: { versionId: row.id } })`. Links: `Link` from @tanstack/react-router (+ Button variant='ghost' for back links) — see app-sidebar.tsx / user-nav.tsx. Tables: ResourceTable<T> with columns ResourceColumn<T>={key;header;cell?;className?}; props {columns,rows:data??[],getRowId,isLoading,isError,error,resourceLabel,emptyState?,onRowClick?}; it already sets cursor-pointer+hover when onRowClick is passed. States: ErrorState shows the standard 401 message automatically; EmptyState/TableLoadingState exist. StatusBadge({status}). PageHeader({title,description?,actions?}). formatDate(iso?:string|null) returns '—' for null/invalid (src/lib/utils.ts). Nullable strings: `value ?? '—'`. Opaque object fields (provenance/evidence/compatibility/blank_structure are { [key:string]: unknown }) must NOT be rendered as columns.
